terra.problem: “David Gets Bread and a Sword” cites 1 Samuel 21:1–7, but Ahimelech gives David the sword in verses 8–9. Extend the passage to 1 Samuel 21:1–9.

“Doeg Tells Saul” describes Doeg’s report and Saul’s summons, which take place with Saul, not at Nob. Also, Saul summons the priests of Ahimelech’s family, rather than the priests’ families generally.
In “Saul Destroys the City of Priests,” the killing of the priests takes place in Saul’s presence; the passage does not say it happens at Nob. Doeg’s attack on the city does happen at Nob.
For fifth-grade readability, consider replacing “consecrated bread” with “bread set apart for God” and “put Nob to the sword” with “killed the people of Nob.”
